items.title: Nearly 80% of ACE Editors Surveyed Are Using AI, New Report Finds: 'You Adapt or Die'
items.excerpt: In an Avid survey of 120 members of the American Cinema Editors, 77.5% of film editors say they already use AI in their work, with editors describing the shift as 'adapt or die'.

items.excerpt: Animaj's AI-assisted preschool series Ozzy Fox, made with Disney Jr., moves to Disney+ as the studio details how animators use its agentic AI pipeline. Off-list (no on-list outlet covered the Disney+ move).

items.title: This Startup Is Betting on AI Microdramas to Get More Black Stories in Hollywood
items.excerpt: Mansa says its AI-generated microdramas can serve as proofs of concept for what Black audiences want; critics say the studio is selling out. Off-list.

items.title: 日, AI로 복제한 유명인 목소리·사진 무단 상업이용 규제 추진
items.excerpt: 일본 정부가 AI로 타인의 목소리나 사진을 복제해 상업적으로 무단 이용하는 행위를 법으로 규제하는 방안을 추진한다. 배우·성우 초상과 음성 보호에 직결되는 조치.

items.title: AI Makes Production Cheap. Without the IP, It Still Doesn't Pay
items.excerpt: Generative AI cut a Pizza Hut commercial from KRW 2 billion to KRW 30 million; short-drama maker Hello Works says it has recouped 30% of its spend, and both firms now steer AI savings into owning IP. Off-list.

items.title: 4BY4 brings AI video enhancement to Mac, DaVinci Resolve and Nuke
items.excerpt: 4BY4 will unveil AI PIXELL PRO for macOS plus DaVinci Resolve and Nuke plug-ins at Inter BEE on Nov. 18 - local processing, perpetual license, aimed at post-production of generated and existing video. Off-list.

items.title: Vir Hirani to voice Mowgli in upcoming AI-generated feature film inspired by The Jungle Book
items.excerpt: An AI-generated Indian feature inspired by The Jungle Book, produced by Sripal Morakhia and directed by Soumitra Ranade, casts actor Vir Hirani as the human voice of Mowgli. Off-list; thin article.

items.title: Skydance Bets On AI To Help Reduce Its $87 Billion Debt Burden
items.excerpt: David Ellison outlined plans to slash $6 billion in annual costs, promising AI will make film production faster and cheaper without replacing artists. Borderline business angle; Ellison remarks seen-but-unpicked earlier.

items.title: When Video Becomes an Interface | inside view
items.excerpt: Inside Runway Labs, designers prototype what real-time video models enable: select anywhere to generate, video that re-renders as you resize it, and a drawing app that animates sketches in your style as you draw.
